definition: Clinical compound phrase meaning oral sex performed on the vagina; used in medical and sexological contexts.
notes: Redundant construction since oral sex on a woman is inherently vaginal; rarely used outside formal health education.

definition: Descriptive clinical phrase meaning 'oral sex on a woman'; used in health education material.

definition: Crude verb phrase meaning 'to lick the cunt'; the most direct vulgar Turkish expression for performing cunnilingus.
notes: 'Am' is the primary vulgar Turkish word for vagina/vulva (≈ English 'cunt'); 'yalamak' = to lick.

definition: Polysemous verb meaning 'to eat'; used in sexual slang to mean performing cunnilingus, parallel to English 'eating out'.

definition: Euphemistic phrase meaning 'to go down'; used for performing oral sex on a partner, structurally borrowed from English 'go down on'.

definition: Slang phrase meaning 'to do a dive'; used for performing cunnilingus, evoking the image of plunging one's face into the genitals.

definition: Loanword from French/English 'masturbation'; the standard clinical Turkish term for self-stimulation of the genitals.
notes: Directly borrowed; universally recognized in Turkey; the default term in health education and medical contexts.

definition: Clinical term for autoeroticism; self-directed sexual arousal and activity, encompassing masturbation and fantasy.

definition: Euphemistic phrase meaning 'manual satisfaction'; a polite circumlocution for masturbation.

definition: Verb phrase meaning 'to masturbate'; combines the loanword stem 'mastürbe' with the auxiliary 'olmak' (to become/be).
notes: Turkish grammatical convention requires adding 'olmak' or 'etmek' to adapt foreign noun/adjective stems into verbs; this is the standard verbal form of the loanword.

definition: The number 'thirty-one' repurposed as the dominant Turkish slang for masturbation; the digits 3 and 1 together visually suggest a hand holding a penis.
notes: Possibly the most culturally entrenched Turkish slang for masturbation; recognized across all ages and regions. Folk etymology: numeral '31' visually encodes the act.

definition: Verb phrase combining the numeral '31' with 'çekmek' (to pull); the standard phrasal form of the masturbation slang.
notes: 'Çekmek' (to pull) mirrors the physical stroking action; this is the most common complete utterance in practice; numeral shorthand dominant in text.

definition: Spelled-out variant of '31 çekmek', writing 'thirty-one pull' in full; functionally identical to the numeral form.
notes: Interchangeable with '31 çekmek'; spelled-out form appears more in written or literary contexts while the numeral shorthand dominates spoken use.

definition: Verb meaning 'to stroke or smooth'; used in slang for masturbation, emphasizing the stroking motion.
notes: Primary meaning is innocent (smoothing a surface, petting an animal); sexual meaning arises from context; ambiguity allows coded use.

definition: Verbal noun from 'ellemek' (to handle, to touch with the hand); used for masturbation or manual genital touching.
notes: 'El' = hand; 'ellemek' has a broader innocent meaning of handling/touching but defaults to masturbation or genital fondling in sexual contexts.

definition: Verb meaning 'to pull'; used as standalone crude slang for masturbation, shorthand extracted from '31 çekmek'.
notes: Context-dependent; in isolation 'çekmek' has many meanings (to pull, to draw, to shoot); the sexual meaning is activated by context or preceding '31'.

definition: Verb meaning 'to cup or grip with the palm'; used as slang for masturbation, emphasizing the gripping action around the penis.
notes: 'Avuç' = palm of the hand; implies a cupping/gripping grip rather than a stroking one; less common than 'çekmek' forms.

definition: Euphemistic phrase meaning 'self-satisfaction'; a polite or clinical circumlocution for masturbation.

definition: Agent noun from 'otuzbir'; literally 'a thirty-one-er', meaning a person who masturbates; also used pejoratively for a useless, idle, or contemptible person.
notes: The '-ci' suffix is standard Turkish agentive; the insult connotation (lazy bum who only masturbates) is prominent in everyday usage and often overshadows the literal meaning.

definition: Loanword compound for anal sex; the standard clinical and colloquial Turkish term for sexual activity involving the anus.

definition: Clinical phrase meaning 'anal intercourse'; 'ilişki' is the standard Turkish word for both 'relationship' and 'intercourse'.
notes: 'İlişki' alone means relationship/intercourse; the compound 'anal ilişki' mirrors the clinical parallel to 'vajinal ilişki' (vaginal intercourse).

definition: Highly technical clinical term meaning 'anal copulation'; used in academic sexology and forensic medicine.
notes: 'Kopülasyon' is borrowed from Latin copulatio; this register is reserved for academic papers and expert testimony; almost never in ordinary discourse.

definition: Clinical phrase meaning 'anal penetration'; specifies insertion into the anus without specifying the penetrating body part.
notes: Broader in scope than 'anal seks' as it encompasses finger, toy, or penile insertion; preferred in medical, legal, and forensic contexts.

definition: Extremely crude verb phrase meaning 'to fuck in the ass'; uses 'göt' (ass) with ablative suffix and 'sikmek', the most vulgar Turkish copulatory verb.
notes: 'Göt' (ass/buttocks) carries a crude score of ~65–70 on its own; 'sikmek' is the harshest Turkish sexual verb (≈ 'to fuck'); the combination is near the ceiling of Turkish vulgarity.
